scope: Candidate soil-type screening relationships for forest and aggregate crop classes, with a separate foundation-support screen. Results are not agronomic recommendations, engineering design values, permits, certifications or Canonical Life decisions.

decision_contract.result_semantics: A provisional compatibility label only indicates a candidate relationship worth testing. It never approves planting, harvest, occupancy, construction, water use, land use or transfer.

screening_status_definitions.meaning: Candidate profile has no type-level conflict for this target, but owner state and site validation remain mandatory.
Candidate profile may be testable only after the named limiting conditions are resolved.
Candidate profile has a material type-level limitation and should not be selected without contrary measured evidence.
This candidate dataset does not provide affirmative support; an external qualified workflow would be required.

crop_support.conditions: Measured water-retention behavior, water-source authority and nutrient-source accounting are unresolved.
crop_support.risk: Rapid drainage and low candidate nutrient retention may conflict with the aggregate class, while local layering may invalidate the type inference.

crop_support.conditions: Owner-approved water and nutrient events plus erosion controls must be represented as paired pool deltas.
crop_support.risk: A type-level label can hide drought, leaching and surface-loss behavior.

crop_support.conditions: Root-zone depth, anchorage, water availability and erosion exposure require site evidence.
crop_support.risk: Texture alone cannot establish long-term anchorage or water supply.

crop_support.conditions: Species composition, regeneration state, water balance and erosion custody remain owner decisions.
crop_support.risk: Forest habitat suitability cannot be inferred from a texture analog alone.

foundation_support.conditions: Density, saturation, scour, liquefaction susceptibility, settlement and load path require qualified site investigation.
foundation_support.risk: Loose or saturated sandy material may respond differently under construction loading.

crop_support.conditions: Measured retention, hydraulic boundaries and authorized water inputs must support the simulated water state.
crop_support.risk: The aggregate crop class may require water behavior not supplied by this profile.

crop_support.conditions: Current fertility, contamination, water and erosion states must pass owner validation.
crop_support.risk: A favorable texture screen does not establish nutrient sufficiency, safety or crop-specific performance.

crop_support.conditions: Root-zone depth, water balance, anchorage and species-specific evidence remain required.

crop_support.risk: No species or succession outcome follows from the type screen.

foundation_support.conditions: Density, saturation, bearing response and settlement require qualified site investigation and design.
foundation_support.risk: Profile variability and loading history are not represented by the type label.

crop_support.risk: Generalized loam behavior cannot establish aggregate rice-class water compatibility.
